_comment: Category taxonomy for QA Affiliate. Add new categories here — pages render automatically, no frontend rebuild needed.

categories.name: Fashion & Clothing
categories.tagline: Dresses, tops, denim and wardrobe staples
categories.description: Timeless staples and seasonal updates for a wardrobe that works harder. We track what is genuinely selling and well-reviewed — from everyday tops to statement outerwear — so you can build outfits without the guesswork.

categories.name: Shoes & Footwear
categories.description: From everyday sneakers to occasion heels, our footwear picks are chosen for comfort, construction and real customer feedback. We watch ratings momentum and bestseller signals to surface pairs actually worth your money.

categories.name: Jewelry
categories.description: Earrings, necklaces, bracelets and rings that look far more expensive than they are. We prioritize pieces with strong ratings and clear material descriptions — and our tarnish guide helps you choose pieces that last.

categories.name: Bags & Handbags
categories.tagline: Totes, crossbody bags, clutches and more
categories.description: Totes, crossbody bags, clutches and backpacks for every routine. We look for thoughtful construction, practical sizing and verified buyer satisfaction before a bag makes the cut.

categories.name: Beauty & Cosmetics
categories.description: Makeup essentials that earn their place in your routine. Every beauty pick is chosen from products with genuine ratings traction — never paid placement — and our brush guide shows you how to use them properly.

categories.name: Skincare
categories.tagline: Cleansers, serums and moisturizers that deliver
categories.description: Cleansers, serums and moisturizers chosen for honest performance. We cross-check ratings, ingredient transparency and routine fit — and our glass-skin guide walks you through building a routine step by step.

categories.name: Hair Care & Styling
categories.description: Styling tools, treatments and accessories for healthier hair days. From heatless curling methods to everyday essentials, we feature products with proven buyer love — and show you exactly how to use them.

categories.name: Women's Accessories
categories.tagline: Scarves, belts, sunglasses and finishing touches
categories.description: The finishing touches: sunglasses, scarves, belts and hats. Small pieces with big impact — curated for quality signals and standout ratings.

categories.name: Lingerie & Underwear
categories.description: Comfort-first intimates and sleepwear. We focus on fit, fabric honesty and real reviews — because this is one category where comfort is non-negotiable.

categories.name: Fitness & Lifestyle
categories.description: Activewear, gear and everyday wellness finds that support an active routine. Chosen for durability signals and genuine buyer feedback.

categories.name: Viral & Trending
categories.tagline: What everyone is talking about right now
categories.description: The products everyone is talking about right now. Every item here earned its tag through rising merchant signals and editorial review — never paid placement.

categories.name: Home & Lifestyle
categories.tagline: Decor, lighting and little upgrades for your space
categories.description: Small, affordable pieces that change how a room feels — accent lighting, wall decor, organizers and decorative touches. We pick items with strong buyer feedback and real-room appeal, verified live on AliExpress.

categories.name: Electronics
categories.description: Affordable gadgets, smartwatches, earbuds and phone accessories — trending tech picks with honest pros and cons.

categories.name: Toys & Kids
categories.description: Trending toys and kid-friendly finds — squishies, learning toys and gift ideas parents actually rebuy.
